description.value: A large full-service hotel in Kamloops featuring a signature tropical atrium with an indoor saltwater pool, hot tub, sauna, and wading pool. Notably the only hotel in Kamloops with an on-site liquor store, and home to Table twelvefifty, a restaurant with valley views from a patio. With 30,000 square feet of event space and a 24-hour front desk, it is a well-equipped base for touring cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the hotel is open and operational. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed as 'free hotel-wide wi-fi' across multiple pages; the on-site restaurant Table twelvefifty is confirmed for evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with confirmed web presence and consistent contact information — a viable overnight stop for touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant Table twelvefifty serves modern cuisine with valley views and a patio
